labels.checkout_unavailable: Checkout is currently unavailable for this offer.
labels.routePinned: Existing obligations retain their original provider. Open obligations
labels.routeMismatch: The requested route differs from the effective provider. Resolve existing obligations before reassignment.
labels.resolveObligations: Resolve pending payments and active subscriptions before changing the effective provider.
labels.overrideNotice: Billing configuration changes do not migrate subscriptions or change accepted terms.
labels.confirmOverride: I confirm this provider assignment change for the selected tenant.
labels.title: Plans and credit purchases
labels.description: Review the terms, register the authorized payer and complete payment. Credits are granted only after verified payment.
labels.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to resume this checkout.
labels.conflict: The command conflicts with current billing state or terms. Refresh and review before continuing.
labels.invalidInput: Check the payer details and billing fields, then try again.
labels.unresolved: The result could not be confirmed. Refresh to recover saved state, or retry the saved command. Do not start another purchase to resolve this attempt.
labels.storageError: Browser session storage is unavailable or contains an invalid checkout command. New purchase commands are blocked until this is resolved.
labels.pendingCommand: A command is awaiting confirmation. Retry preserves its original identity and terms.
labels.expiry: Included credits expire at the end of their original monthly period and do not roll over. Late payment does not extend the period. This subscription creates recurring monthly charges.
labels.purchaseTerms: Purchased credits are separate from monthly allowances and survive subscription renewal.
labels.noOffers: No offers are available for the selected country, or the commercial catalog is unavailable.
labels.agree: I am authorized to purchase for this tenant and accept the price, credit allowance, billing interval and expiry terms shown above.
labels.sandbox: Test environment: this is a test checkout.
labels.cancellationPending: Cancellation is awaiting confirmation. Check the original subscription to recover its status; no repeated cancellation is sent.
labels.stopSubscriptionTerms: Permanently stop this subscription and delete its unpaid charges. Paid credits keep their original expiry; this does not request a refund.
labels.subscription_ACTIVE: Recurrence is active. Credits still require verified payment.
labels.subscription_INACTIVE: Recurrence is inactive. Existing unpaid charges may remain.
labels.subscription_EXPIRED: Recurrence has ended. Existing unpaid charges may remain.
labels.name: Full name or legal company name
labels.payerNotice: The payer is registered for this organization. Payer details are not saved in browser storage.
labels.existingPayer: The registered payer for this tenant will be used. Contact your administrator if the payer must change.
labels.chargeNotice: This creates the payment or recurring subscription at the accepted price. Payment details are entered on the secure external payment page.
labels.unknownCreation: Creation is awaiting confirmation. Recovery looks up the original request and does not create another charge.
labels.payment_pending: Payment is pending. Opening a link does not confirm payment or grant credits.
labels.payment_paid: Payment received or confirmed. Credits are processed separately after verification; check balance and history.
labels.payment_review_required: This payment requires billing review. No payment link is offered for this state.
labels.recentLimit: Showing the 25 most recent checkouts. Older checkouts remain accessible through their saved checkout URL.
labels.state_completed: Purchase processing complete — see balance and history for funding or reversals
labels.market_ineligible: This offer is unavailable in the billing country.
labels.billing_route_missing: No billing provider is configured for this country.
labels.billing_provider_unavailable: Sales are not enabled for this billing provider.
labels.billing_currency_unsupported: This provider does not support the offer currency.
labels.billing_operation_unsupported: This purchase type is not enabled.
labels.billing_integration_pinned: Existing billing obligations are tied to another integration. Contact billing support.
